BOTH wrists remain trapped THROUGH the TWO occupied holes, hands projecting forward with fingers loose, never gripping the wood. The stock must move with her arms. Keep her exact hunched strong creature mass, mask, hair, dress and chains.
Her clothing is the SAME opaque dirty GRAY dress everywhere, including chest. No pale breast patch, bare chest, large spot or new tear. Add only ONE tiny dark dusty speck, the size of a pea, on the upper-chest fabric below the mask; it marks the first impact without blood or exposed injury. The dress must otherwise remain unchanged.
Chris keeps the EXACT black pump shotgun aiming pose of image 1, both black fingerless gloves, same actor and outfit. Shift only his rear foot a small step back toward the left doorway. This is AFTER one shot, not a firing moment: no flash, casing or new projectile. Preserve cabin, camera, two characters, clear floor route and light. Real practical cinematic live-action 16:9 photograph. References 2/3 supply Chris identity only; 4 supplies shotgun. No text, collage or extra objects.
